note: From OpenStreetMap's main API (14 October 2026, data/raw/crewe/wilmslow.json, tools/osm-to-kit.mjs), at real scale; positive v is east. Four platforms, numbered west to east as OpenStreetMap has them: 1, a side platform on the Styal line's west track, by the booking hall; 2 and 3, an island between the Styal line's east track (2) and the Crewe line's track towards Manchester (3, the halt's); 4, a side platform on the Crewe line's track towards Crewe, the second platform. The Styal pair runs beside the Crewe line through the station, spreads to clear the island and joins it at Wilmslow South Junction about 300 m south; it's drawn as scenery rails until the Styal line is in the network, and platforms 1 and 2 are the platforms stage. OpenStreetMap puts the Styal tracks about 2.6 m apart between platforms 1 and 2, too close for two trains, so they're drawn 3.6 m apart and platform 1 0.6 m further west than it has it. The platforms' cores run from the Macclesfield Road bridge north to about u 145; their real tails south over the bridge (3 to u -176, 1 to -159, 4 to -125) are the extension. The subway at u -34 from the booking hall to every platform, the booking hall's outline and the platform buildings are OpenStreetMap's; heights, the roofs and the lifts are from memory. Photos (docs/reference/photos/wilmslow): geograph 7796164 JThomas 2024 and 5639390 Gerald England 2017 (the long low booking hall under a slate roof behind its forecourt), 5639398 Gerald England (the bus stop on the approach), 5950889 philandju 2018 and 5000395 JThomas 2016 (long canopies on iron columns, the brick building on platform 4), 6605336 N Chadwick 2019 (the glazed-roof building on the island), 5219510 Jaggery 2016 and 4158810, 4158468, 4429948 Jaggery 2014 (the forecourt, the entrance, the bridge over Macclesfield Road); all CC BY-SA 2.0. View from above: docs/reference/aerial/wilmslow.jpg (LIDAR). The car parks are OpenStreetMap's surface car parks off Station Road (the forecourt's and the one beyond it; no multi-storey in OpenStreetMap, so the second is a surface car park); the taxi rank, the cycle stands, the canopies' extents and the barriers are placed by eye from memory.
